keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: 1–20 phrases, each 1–200 characters. OR search across TED full text. Quotes, backslashes, wildcards and control characters are rejected.

country.title: Buyer country
country.description: Three-letter TED country code (FRA, DEU, ESP…). Empty string or null removes the country filter. Format is validated; code membership is not checked.

days.title: Days
days.description: Publication date >= UTC today minus this many days (inclusive).

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Score at most this many newest TED matches, then write them in descending fit_score order.

company_profile.title: Company profile (optional)
company_profile.description: All fields optional. Budget comparisons require exactly one preferred currency. Employees are informational only. Services and CPV codes affect scoring, not the TED candidate search.

services.title: Services
services.description: Service phrases matched locally against market titles and descriptions.

cpv_codes.title: Cpv Codes
cpv_codes.description: Exact eight-digit CPV codes; optional checkdigit is ignored, not validated.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Non-negative employee count; informational, no eligibility inference.

min_contract_value.title: Min Contract Value
min_contract_value.description: Inclusive minimum estimate in the single preferred currency.

max_contract_value.title: Max Contract Value
max_contract_value.description: Inclusive maximum estimate in the single preferred currency.

preferred_currencies.title: Preferred Currencies
preferred_currencies.description: Preferred three-letter currencies; exactly one required to compare budgets.
